authorization.summary: User authorized Apify Google review backfill for sewer-specific classification and public sewer-review UI.

policyNote: Discovery + website/Census-backed directory fields permitted. User authorized Apify review backfill (condition 5 scope change) for ephemeral raw review processing and durable sewer-derived counts/tags only. Raw review text is not retained beyond retentionHours. Overall Google AggregateRating remains blocked. Public sewer-review badge uses sewer-specific counts only.

placeId.notes: Opaque Place ID for dedupe and review backfill targeting

businessIdentity.notes: Publish only after website or official-registry recapture

coordinates.notes: Never persist Google Maps coordinates into site JSON

overallRating.notes: No AggregateRating JSON-LD; overall star rating not published

overallReviewCount.notes: Overall Google review count may display as context; never relabel as sewer reviews

rawReviewText.notes: Ephemeral only; delete within retentionHours after classification

sewerReviewClassification.notes: Derived tags/lanes from sewer-specific review text; user-authorized Apify path

sewerReviewCount.notes: Public badge shows N sewer review(s) only; user-authorized Apify path

reviewSummary.notes: Flash may summarize sewer-derived evidence; do not paste raw Google review text

reviewExcerpt.notes: No verbatim Google review excerpts in the public site

attributionNote: When sewer-review counts are shown, disclose website/review research and do not imply Google endorsement. Never emit AggregateRating/Review JSON-LD for third-party Google reviews.
